token.label: API Key
token.description: To obtain your free Supadata API Key, sign up at [Supadata](https://supadata.ai) and then copy the key available in the [dashboard](https://dash.supadata.ai).

get_transcript.label: Get Transcript
get_transcript.description: Fetches transcript of a YouTube video.

url.label: YouTube URL
url.description: The URL of a single YouTube video.

lang.label: Language Preference
lang.description: Preferred language of the transcript. If not available, the first available language will be returned.

text.label: Merge Text
text.description: If true, the transcript will be merged into a single text instead of timestamped chunks.

supadata_get_transcript.label: Get Transcript From URL
supadata_get_transcript.description: Fetches the transcript of a video on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X or Facebook, or of a public media file.

url.label: Video URL
url.description: URL of the video or media file.

lang.label: Language
lang.description: Preferred transcript language (ISO 639-1 code), e.g. en.

text.label: Merge Text
text.description: If true, returns the transcript as one text block instead of timestamped chunks.

chunkSize.label: Chunk Size
chunkSize.description: Maximum characters per chunk when Merge Text is off.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: native uses existing transcripts only, generate forces AI transcription, auto tries native then AI.

supadata_get_transcript_job.label: Get Transcript Job
supadata_get_transcript_job.description: Checks the status and result of an asynchronous transcript job.

jobId.label: Job ID
jobId.description: The job id returned by supadata_get_transcript.

supadata_get_media_metadata.label: Get Media Metadata
supadata_get_media_metadata.description: Fetches metadata of a post or video on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X or Facebook.

url.label: Media URL
url.description: URL of the post or video.

supadata_get_youtube_video.label: Get YouTube Video
supadata_get_youtube_video.description: Fetches metadata of a YouTube video.

supadata_get_youtube_channel.label: Get YouTube Channel
supadata_get_youtube_channel.description: Fetches metadata of a YouTube channel.

id.label: Channel ID, Handle or URL
id.description: YouTube channel URL, handle (e.g. @name) or id.

supadata_list_youtube_channel_videos.label: List YouTube Channel Videos
supadata_list_youtube_channel_videos.description: Lists video ids of a YouTube channel.

id.label: Channel ID, Handle or URL
id.description: YouTube channel URL, handle (e.g. @name) or id.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of ids to return.

type.label: Type
type.description: Which kind of videos to list.

supadata_get_youtube_playlist.label: Get YouTube Playlist
supadata_get_youtube_playlist.description: Fetches metadata of a YouTube playlist.

supadata_list_youtube_playlist_videos.label: List YouTube Playlist Videos
supadata_list_youtube_playlist_videos.description: Lists video ids of a YouTube playlist.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of ids to return.

supadata_search_youtube.label: Search YouTube
supadata_search_youtube.description: Searches YouTube for videos, channels and playlists.

uploadDate.label: Upload Date
uploadDate.description: Filter by upload date (videos and movies only).

duration.label: Duration
duration.description: short is under 4 minutes, medium 4-20 minutes, long over 20 minutes (videos and movies only).

features.label: Features
features.description: Special features to filter by (videos and movies only).

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of results; the API paginates automatically up to this many.

nextPageToken.label: Next Page Token
nextPageToken.description: Token from a previous search to fetch the next page.

supadata_start_video_extraction.label: Start Video Extraction
supadata_start_video_extraction.description: Starts an AI job extracting structured data from a video.

url.label: Video URL
url.description: URL of the video or media file.

schema.label: Schema
schema.description: JSON Schema describing the output format.

supadata_get_video_extraction_result.label: Get Video Extraction Result
supadata_get_video_extraction_result.description: Checks the status and result of a video extraction job.

jobId.label: Job ID
jobId.description: The job id returned by supadata_start_video_extraction.

supadata_scrape_web_page.label: Scrape Web Page
supadata_scrape_web_page.description: Extracts the content of a web page as Markdown.

url.label: URL
url.description: URL of the page to scrape.

noLinks.label: Exclude Links
noLinks.description: If true, links are stripped from the Markdown.

supadata_map_website.label: Map Website
supadata_map_website.description: Lists the URLs found on a website.

supadata_get_account.label: Get Account
supadata_get_account.description: Fetches the organization, plan and credit usage of the API key.
